why: No expressive control is documented; only the choice of voice.

expressive.method: Inline tags from a fixed list
expressive.quote: Write each tag in lowercase English exactly as HeyGen lists it
expressive.text: [calm] Take a slow breath in, [pause] and let it go. [warm] You are calm and confident when you speak. It is already done. Feel how natural it is. [gentle] You wake up, and it is simply true: you are calm and confident when you speak. You no longer hope for this. You live from it. [slowly] When a doubt rises, you watch it pass like a cloud. [softly] You are grateful. [pause] You are calm. [pause] You are certain. [warm] You are calm and confident when you speak. [softly] And so it is.

note: Open model. 300 characters per request, so long scripts are stitched.

expressive.quote: You can additionally add the following emotive tags
expressive.text: Take a slow breath in, and let it go. <sigh> You are calm and confident when you speak. It is already done. Feel how natural it is. You wake up, and it is simply true: you are calm and confident when you speak. You no longer hope for this. You live from it. When a doubt rises, you watch it pass like a cloud. <sigh> You are grateful. You are calm. You are certain. You are calm and confident when you speak. And so it is.

note: Open model. 200 characters per request, so long scripts are stitched.
Launch price until 30 Nov 2026. Fish Audio's list price is $50 per 1M, five times this. Default voice.

expressive.quote: Write it the way you'd brief a voice actor: emotion, intent, pacing
expressive.text: [calm, warm, unhurried guided-meditation voice] Take a slow breath in, and let it go. You are calm and confident when you speak. It is already done. Feel how natural it is. [gentle, reassuring] You wake up, and it is simply true: you are calm and confident when you speak. You no longer hope for this. You live from it. When a doubt rises, you watch it pass like a cloud. [softer and slower, almost a whisper] You are grateful. You are calm. You are certain. [warm, quietly certain] You are calm and confident when you speak. And so it is.

expressive.method: Style instruction, sent separately from the script
expressive.quote: Gemini 3.8 TTS treats the text field strictly as a verbatim transcript.
expressive.instructions: A warm, calm, reassuring guided-meditation voice. Speak slowly, with gentle pauses between sentences.

expressive.quote: write them inline in input, in square brackets, such as [emotion=happy] or [pace=slow]
expressive.text: [emotion=calm][pace=slow] Take a slow breath in, and let it go. [breath] You are calm and confident when you speak. It is already done. Feel how natural it is. [emotion=warm][pace=slow] You wake up, and it is simply true: you are calm and confident when you speak. You no longer hope for this. You live from it. When a doubt rises, you watch it pass like a cloud. [emotion=reflective][pace=very-slow] You are grateful. You are calm. You are certain. [emotion=warm][pace=slow] You are calm and confident when you speak. And so it is.

note: Replaces Fish Audio S1, which retires on 31 Dec 2026. Same price on Fish Audio's own API. Default voice.

expressive.quote: Bracket cues can use natural language descriptions and are not limited to a fixed set of tags
expressive.text: [calm] Take a slow breath in, [break] and let it go. [soft tone] You are calm and confident when you speak. It is already done. Feel how natural it is. [relaxed] You wake up, and it is simply true: you are calm and confident when you speak. You no longer hope for this. You live from it. [calm] When a doubt rises, you watch it pass like a cloud. [whispering] You are grateful. [break] You are calm. [break] You are certain. [soft tone] You are calm and confident when you speak. [long-break] And so it is.

expressive.method: Inline tags from a fixed list
expressive.quote: Add inline speech tags to your text for expressive delivery.
expressive.text: [inhale] Take a slow breath in, [exhale] and let it go. [pause] You are calm and confident when you speak. It is already done. Feel how natural it is. [long-pause] You wake up, and it is simply true: you are calm and confident when you speak. You no longer hope for this. You live from it. [pause] When a doubt rises, you watch it pass like a cloud. [long-pause] <whisper>You are grateful. You are calm. You are certain.</whisper> [pause] You are calm and confident when you speak. [long-pause] And so it is.

note: The more expressive of the two Gemini 3.8 voices.

expressive.method: Free-form audio tags in square brackets
expressive.quote: Audio tags (e.g. [whispering], [shouting], [laughing]) let you direct delivery with fine-grained control
expressive.text: [Quiet, warm, reflective narration] Take a slow breath in... and let it go. [exhales] You are calm and confident when you speak. It is already done. Feel how natural it is. [pauses] You wake up, and it is simply true: you are calm and confident when you speak. You no longer hope for this. You live from it. [pauses] When a doubt rises, you watch it pass like a cloud. [whispers] You are grateful. You are calm. You are certain. [warm, certain] You are calm and confident when you speak. [pauses] And so it is.

note: Older preview; Google is replacing it with the 3.8 voices.

expressive.method: Stage direction written into the script
expressive.syntax: Say this slowly, in a warm, calm voice: …
expressive.quote: Unlike earlier preview models where stage directions were embedded in plain text
expressive.text: Say this slowly, in a warm, calm, reassuring voice, with gentle pauses between sentences: Take a slow breath in, and let it go. You are calm and confident when you speak. It is already done. Feel how natural it is. You wake up, and it is simply true: you are calm and confident when you speak. You no longer hope for this. You live from it. When a doubt rises, you watch it pass like a cloud. You are grateful. You are calm. You are certain. You are calm and confident when you speak. And so it is.

note: Free. Fish Audio describes it as for testing and prototyping; no quota or commercial-use terms are published on its pricing page.
